test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 06 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate collocating word to fill in the blank.**

Great people are always ready to _________ responsibilities.
solution:
The correct answer is: **shoulder**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look at the **meaning **of the given words.

 
 
• **Kindle**: Arouse or inspire an emotion or feeling. (किसी भाव या भावना को जगाना या प्रेरित करना)
 
• **Secure**: Certain to remain safe and unthreatened.
